profile.name: Shen Chen (陈燊)
profile.title: Researcher
bio: I am a Researcher at Tencent Youtu Lab, where I work on computer vision and machine learning. And my research interests are deepfake detection, face anti-spoofing and image forensics.
I finished the master's study and obtained my M.S. degree from Xiamen University in 2021, advised by Prof. Rongrong Ji. Earlier, I received the B.S.degree from Fuzhou University in 2018.

1 paper accepted by ECCV 2022, with the acceptance rate to be 26%
1 paper accepted by CVPR 2022, with the acceptance rate to be 25.33%
2 papers accepted by AAAI 2022, with the acceptance rate to be 15%
Our Team won the second place in 3D High-Fidelity Mask Attack Detection Challenge (ICCV2021)
1 paper accepted by AAAI 2021, with the acceptance rate to be 21%
Our Team won the second place in DeeperForensics Challenge (ECCV 2020)
Our Team won the gold medal in Deepfake Detection Challenge
